a. 
(-द्रा-द्री f.) [रुद्र-अण्] 
__1 ‘Rudra-like’, violent, irascible, wrathful. 
__2 Fierce, savage, terrible, wild. 
__3 Addressed to Rudra (as a hymn). 
__4 Bringing misfortune, calamitous. 
__5 Relating to Rudra; रौद्रं व्रतं समास्थाय नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः [[

.]] 
-द्रः 
__1 A worshipper of Rudra. 
__2 Heat, ardour, warmth, passion, wrath. 
__3 The sentiment of wrath or furiousness; रौद्रः [Page1352-1] क्रोधस्थायिभावो रक्तो रुद्राधिदैवतः [[S.

.]] 
__4 N. of Yama. 
__5 Winter. 
__6 N. of a संवत्सर. 
-द्रम् 
__1 Wrath, rage. 
__2 Formidableness, fierceness, savageness. 
__3 Heat, warmth; solar heat. 
-Comp. 
-कर्मन् a. doing dreadful acts. (-n.) a terrible magic rite. 
-दर्शन a. frightful-looking, terrific.
